$comment: One observable claim per criterion (docs/research-4.md). calibrate.mjs holds the answer key for each id; the ids must match.

criteria.check: Something in the world changes without the player causing it, such as a bell tolling or a market closing.
At least one refusal is spoken by a character in their own words rather than shown as a system message.
Every prompt tells the player what kinds of input the game accepts.
The game's response changes depending on what the player types.
At least one action spends a limited resource whose remaining amount the player can see.
The game states a goal for the player to work toward.
Returning to a place shows something different from what it showed on the earlier visit.
The player is never trapped in a place with no way out.
